s4_attain_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region;
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) AS total_closed_revenue FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region;
s4_attain_advneg: WITH advneg_reps AS (SELECT DISTINCT hb.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN advneg_reps ar ON o.employee_id = ar.employee_id;
s4_attain_no_advneg: WITH advneg_reps AS (SELECT DISTINCT hb.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg_reps);
s4_attain_by_advneg: WITH advneg_reps AS (SELECT DISTINCT hb.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') SELECT CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg_reps) THEN 'Completed Advanced Negotiation' ELSE 'Did Not Complete' END AS advneg_status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o GROUP BY advneg_status;
s4_assess_emea: WITH emea_reps AS (SELECT sr.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr WHERE sr.sales_region = 'EMEA') SELECT AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores a JOIN learners l ON a.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN emea_reps er ON hb.employee_id = er.employee_id;
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id WHERE sr.sales_region = 'EMEA';
s4_attain_by_distract: WITH distract_reps AS (SELECT DISTINCT hb.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email WHERE c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets') SELECT CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM distract_reps) THEN 'Completed Intro to Spreadsheets' ELSE 'Did Not Complete' END AS status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o GROUP BY status;
s5_advneg_lift: WITH advneg_reps AS (SELECT DISTINCT hb.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON hb.work_email = l.email WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') SELECT (SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg_reps)) - (SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg_reps)) AS attainment_lift;
s4_unans_manager: SELECT NULL AS manager, NULL AS avg_quota_attainment, 'Cannot be answered: no manager or reporting-line information exists in the schema' AS note;
s4_unans_age: SELECT NULL AS age_band, NULL AS avg_assessment_score, 'Cannot be answered: no learner age or age-band information exists in the schema' AS note;
